theme: An open day before a full Sunday.
greeting: A rare clear Saturday, Dan — the girls are with you and Mike at the Coffee Pot cottage and nothing is on the calendar. The open hours are yours, and a couple of overdue decisions would be well spent in them.

needsAttention.title: Walk into the Sunday review ready
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute Mike + Dan review needs the board clean first: empty the inbox, put an owner and a date on everything, promote what's active this week. A glance tonight keeps it to fifteen minutes.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — flagged to book weeks ago. Book it refundable now and adjust the dates once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December trip
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist three destinations for all four kids over Dec 13–Jan 2; the decide-by and book-by dates have both passed and holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. Default domestic unless someone wants international.

flagged.title: LinkedIn invite from an IFAC director
flagged.detail: A connection request from a Director of Education at IFAC is waiting on a response — governance-adjacent networking.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters, shop sales, travel and real-estate alerts.
inbox.clear: No email is actually waiting on a reply from you — the Airbnb host thread is just friendly back-and-forth.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its peak now, sweet and dense after the first cold nights.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Drive the Pathfinder south (window has passed)
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: A clear Saturday — nothing on the calendar, the girls with you and Mike in St. Pete.
Still wide open; the overdue Christmas SUV and the December-trip decision are the hour that would actually pay off.
Quiet at the cottage — skim the Mike + Dan board tonight so tomorrow's 9 AM review runs clean.
